domain.question: Which launchers, prompt templates, and schemas must be frozen the moment the first implementation wave starts, and what is the exact versioned-migration procedure for changing each one afterwards?
domain.title: Launcher and schema freeze inventory with a versioned-migration requirement

versioned_migration_procedure.accept: numbered migration with executable down-step and a version bump
versioned_migration_procedure.refuse: in-place edit after freeze with no version bump or no migration
steps: Refuse any in-place edit of a frozen path after the freeze anchors are recorded.
Copy the current freeze-anchor bytes as the migration down-fixture.
Apply the change in a scratch copy of that path only.
Bump the embedded version (JSON schema_version or Python __freeze_version__/FREEZE_VERSION).
Record a migration {id, path, from_sha256, to_sha256, from_version, to_version, up, down}.
Run the freeze change-detection check: it must be GREEN only with both the bump and the matching migration.
Execute down then up on the scratch copy and require the original freeze-anchor sha256 to round-trip.
Only then replace the freeze-anchor sha256/version in the inventory.
